name: siteverdict
description: Website audits (GDPR consent, speed, WCAG, SPF/DMARC, AI search) plus optional business toolsets: leads, compliance, travel, SEO, UK property.
long_description: SiteVerdict gives Claude read-mostly business tools backed by Apify Actors. The default 'web' toolset audits any public website: tracking & cookie consent (Consent Mode v2, tags before consent), Core Web Vitals with a revenue-loss estimate, WCAG 2.2 / European Accessibility Act checks, domain and email health (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TLS), AI-search readiness, tech-stack detection, change/uptime monitoring and clean Markdown with citations. Optional toolsets add marketing (rankings, Search Console + GA4 diagnosis, Google ad transparency, own reviews), leads (local businesses, SEC/GLEIF registries, UK/EU tenders), compliance (sanctions screening, VAT/company-number validation, PDF invoice extraction), travel (fares, deals, UK261/EU261, visa rules) and UK property data. Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-event, spend-capped per run). Not legal, financial, immigration or valuation advice.

author.name: Aman Thakran (BharatFare Travel and Technologies Ltd)
